name: Grand Hyatt Al Khobar
positioning: Grand Hyatt Al Khobar Hotel and Residences: a city hotel with serviced residences in the Al Olaya District, with direct access to Al Rashid Mall
best_for: Travelers who want direct access to Al Rashid Mall
Long-stay guests who want an apartment with a kitchen
Guests who want club-lounge access or a large suite

facts.text: The hotel is in the Al Olaya District of Al Khobar.
Rooms and suites offer ample daylight and city or courtyard views.
Rooms have a marble bathroom with a soaking tub and rain shower.
The hotel offers serviced residences suited to business, leisure or long-term stays.
The One-Bedroom Apartment has a separate living and dining room, a kitchen, a guest toilet and a deep soaking tub.
The Nirvana Spa and Fitness Center has LifeFitness treadmills, bicycles, cross trainers, spinning bikes and free weights.
Guests can explore the area's history and culture at Heritage Village and the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture, known as Ithra.
The hotel has 2,300 square meters of meeting space.
Sakana House serves pan-Asian cuisine with flavors from Japan, China and across the region.
Grandeur Lounge, the lobby lounge, serves freshly brewed Arabic coffee, teas and local dates.

highlights.text: The hotel has direct access to Al Rashid Mall.
Nirvana Spa has a Royal Moroccan hammam.
The 138-square-meter Diplomatic Suite has a separate living room, dining room and fully equipped kitchen.
Club rooms include access to the Grand Club, serving complimentary breakfast, refreshments and evening canapes.
The lap swimming pool features mood lighting, relaxation beds and a snack bar.

considerations.text: King Fahd International Airport is 53.7 kilometers from the hotel.
Room views are of the city or a courtyard.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.
